data.name: Widyaan
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'widyan' which means 'to know' or 'to gain knowledge'. It is a name that embodies the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. It is also a name that signifies intelligence, understanding, and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects one's deep connection to knowledge and wisdom, and a desire to continuously learn and grow.
data.numerology_meaning: A name that represents the number 6, which is associated with love, nurturing, and harmony.

in_arabic.name: ويديان
in_arabic.meaning: ويديان تعني الأراضي الواسعة أو السهول الممتدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ويديان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'و-ي-د' الذي يحمل معاني الاتساع والامتداد، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصف الأراضي والمساحات الواسعة. يشير إلى الأراضي الواسعة أو السهول الممتدة، مما يعكس صورة الأرض الخصبة والمباركة. في التقاليد الإسلامية، يرتبط الاسم بمعاني الخصوبة والنماء.

in_urdu.name: ویدیان
in_urdu.meaning: ویدیان کا مطلب وسیع زمینیں یا وسیع میدان
in_urdu.long_meaning: ویدیان نام عربی جڑ 'و-ي-د' سے نکلا ہے، جس کے معنی پھیلاؤ اور وسعت کے ہیں۔ یہ نام وسیع زمینوں یا کھلے میدانوں کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، جو زمین کی خصوبت اور برکت کی تصویر کشی کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایات میں، یہ نام خصوبت اور نمو کے معانی سے وابستہ ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں جہاں عربی اشتقاقیات کو اہمیت دی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: विद्यान
in_hindi.meaning: विद्यान का अर्थ विस्तृत भूमि या विशाल मैदान
in_hindi.long_meaning: विद्यान नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'و-ي-د' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है विस्तार और व्यापकता। यह नाम विस्तृत भूमियों या विशाल मैदानों को संदर्भित करता है, जो पृथ्वी की उर्वरता और आशीर्वाद को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अरबी शाब्दिक अर्थों के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है, जो प्राकृतिक और आध्यात्मिक विकास की भावनाओं को प्रतिबिंबित करता है।

in_pashto.name: ويديان
in_pashto.meaning: ويديان معنی پراخه ځمکه یا پراخه میدان
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ويديان نوم په عربي ژبه کې د 'و-ي-د' په جڑ څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د پراخه او غزېږنې دي. دا نوم پراخه ځمکو یا پراخه میدانونو ته اشاره کوي، کوم چې د ځمکې د حاصلخیز او برکت انځورګرۍ کوي. په افغان او پښتني دودونو کې، دا نوم د خصوبت او ودې د معاني سره تړاو لري، په ځانګړي ډول د عربي اشتقاقي لغت په پښتو ثقافت کې.

in_english.name: Widyaan
in_english.meaning: Widyaan means vast lands or expansive plains
in_english.long_meaning: The name Widyaan is derived from the Arabic root 'و-ي-د', which conveys meanings of spaciousness and extension. It refers to vast lands or expansive plains, reflecting the image of fertile and blessed earth. In Islamic traditions, the name is associated with connotations of fertility and growth. Etymologically linked to Quranic descriptions of landscapes, Widyaan signifies broad horizons and unlimited potential, resonating across various Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Widyaan carries a strong cultural significance for many Muslims, as education and the pursuit of knowledge are highly valued in Islamic tradition. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Seeking knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim," (Bukhari & Muslim). This hadith emphasizes the importance of learning and acquiring knowledge, which is reflected in the name Widyaan. Historically, Islamic universities played a significant role in the preservation and dissemination of knowledge in the Muslim world, and this legacy continues to inspire many to pursue their education with dedication and purpose.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Widyaan can be seen as a reminder of the importance of not only seeking knowledge externally but also gaining inner wisdom and enlightenment. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The seeking of knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim," but he also emphasized that this knowledge should be used to better understand and follow the guidance of Allah. In the Quran, Allah says, "And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant [which] He ratified with you when you said, 'We hear and we obey; [we seek] Your forgiveness.' And complete the [Hajj] pilgrimage and vest yourselves with the garments of servitude to Allah. But indeed, the best garment is the garment of faith. So righteous are those who believe." (Al-Baqarah 2:286) By embracing the name Widyaan, one can strive to seek both external and internal knowledge and wisdom as guided by Allah, ultimately leading to a more meaningful and fulfilling spiritual life.
